text:
maya.ceo: Quick update — Hosted StreamBridge is GA today :tada: (single hosted endpoint for streaming + tool orchestration).

kai.prod: Summary: /v3/streambridge provides chunked streaming frames, structured tool events, built-in retry/fallback policies, and a lightweight orchestration fee on top of token pricing. Targeted at interactive agents and realtime assistants.

oliver.eng: Implementation note: this is an API-layer orchestration; model runtimes unchanged. Bridge agent manages ordering, tool process lifecycle, and idempotent retries. Deployed to hosted pools just now.

sara.docs: Docs + migration guide up: https://docs.redwood.ai/streambridge/migrate — includes Node/Python snippets and a FAQ on tool auth.

opsguy.sre: Monitoring: created dashboard (bridge.p50/p95, stream-connections, tool-failure-rate). Initial alert thresholds: p95 > 600ms or tool-failure-rate > 1.5% will trigger oncall. Canary started at 1955551500.

maya.ceo: Rollout plan: internal -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% over 72 hours with gates. Old /v2/stream-tools will be supported for 120 days read-only, 90 days write-before-sunset. We will email customers and inject an in-app banner.

kai.prod: Pricing note: streaming tokens billed as usual + orchestration fee per bridge call. Sales & finance have the pricing matrix.

oliver.eng: Known limits for GA: max concurrent tool calls per request = 4, max stream idle = 8m, tool call timeout = 45s. We'll iterate.

sara.docs: Example (curl streaming):
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v3/streambridge \
  -d '{"model":"mosaicx-lite-2","prompt":"Find answers and call tools when needed","tools":[{"name":"kb_lookup","url":"https://svc.internal/kb"}],"stream":true}'
```

cs-bot: KB and CS playbook: https://internal.redwood/kb/streambridge-ga 

opsguy.sre: Jenkins: bridge-agent v1.0.1 rolled to hosted pools at 1955551600 — health checks green.

maya.ceo: Action items: ENG monitor canary metrics 0-72h (oliver.eng), DOCS add migration snippets to quickstarts (sara.docs), CS prepare email and banner (cs-bot). Ping here for major regressions. Great work team :rocket:
